retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast close-up portrait in purple-tinted monochrome paired with a top-left corner graphic featuring jagged, overlapping geometric shapes and stylized geometric lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast facial portrait with a purple/magenta tint, featuring a graphic lockup in the upper left corner composed of irregular, torn-edge geometric planes in contrasting colors like teal, maroon, and purple, housing stylized, thin-stroke geometric lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast portrait vs. flat geometric graphic
Monochromatic subject vs. multi-colored graphic accent
Tight facial framing vs. corner-weighted typography
Jagged, torn edges vs. clean geometric letterforms
coreInvariants: Upper-left corner graphic anchor with jagged edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait filling the right two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The graphic block in the top-left corner acts as the primary focal point for information.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left graphic, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then circles back to the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the face and the graphic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and magenta tones in the photographic portrait.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and maroon within the geometric graphic shapes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows and bright highlights; the graphic elements use muted, desaturated 80s tones.
paletteRestrictions: Teal, maroon, and dark purple for graphics

letterConstructionRules: Open counters and disconnected strokes in specific characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: S-shape constructed from three distinct diagonal and horizontal segments
A-shape with a high, horizontal crossbar
Y-shape with a deep, sharp V-junction
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly stylized custom display type paired with a clean, widely-spaced functional sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Overlapping translucent or solid color planes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp angles and thin strokes of the display text.
Provides the necessary geometric rigidity for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, close-up portrait of a person with 80s hair, tinted entirely in deep purple and magenta tones. In the top-left corner, place a collage of jagged, irregular geometric shapes in teal, maroon, and dark purple.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom geometric lettering in white over the top-left shapes. The letters should be thin-stroked with sharp angles. Add a secondary line of widely-spaced, bold sans-serif text at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Are the top-left shapes jagged and overlapping?
Is the display text thin and geometric?
Is the bottom text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Stroke weight of the display lettering
Tracking of the bottom metadata text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact arrangement of the jagged shapes
Unique character constructions of the custom lettering

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean vector edges for graphics

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple tint doesn't wash out facial details.
Check that the jagged shapes look intentional and not like digital artifacts.
Verify the display text is legible against the multi-colored background.
Confirm the bottom text is perfectly centered and horizontally aligned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Purple-tinted portrait + jagged corner collage + geometric thin-stroke lettering = 80s Pop Rock Aesthetic.
